plan.title: fix(install,hooks): no consumer deposits in this repo; render in worktrees; recovery on Codex

narratives.Description: In linked worktrees of this repository, a setup or deposit step appends the consumer `.gitattributes` block to the tracked file, so workers restore it by hand before each commit and `task check` refuses them for a file they did not touch. `task packs:render-skills` reads the skills of the pinned runtime package under node_modules instead of the worktree it runs in, so skill changes were mirrored into the pack by hand. This story makes the one `.gitattributes` writer skip a framework-source checkout and makes the pack-migrate verbs read and write the invoking checkout when it is this repository; Codex install recovery is out of scope (#6375).
narratives.UserStory: As an agent working in a linked worktree of the Directive repository, I want install, setup and session steps to leave `.gitattributes` alone and pack renders to use my worktree's content, so that I stop restoring files and mirroring skill edits by hand.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/doctor/paths.ts: export the existing `isFrameworkSourceCheckoutAt` marker test (no copy).
2. packages/core/src/init-deposit/scaffold.ts: `ensureGitattributes` returns false without writing when `isFrameworkSourceCheckoutAt(projectDir)` is true. `depositNeutralization` and the runtime `ensureManagedPathGitattributes` get the skip through the writer.
3. packages/runtime/src/dispatch.ts: the five pack-migrate verbs resolve their default roots from the invoking project root (process cwd) when it is a framework-source checkout by the same test; otherwise they resolve as today. Explicit flags still win.
4. Tests: core test for the writer (linked worktree with the neutralization deposit, dogfood `.deft/core` checkout, consumer project); runtime test for the setup path in a linked worktree; runtime test for pack-migrate roots (linked worktree with an edited SKILL.md, references and output in that worktree, consumer unchanged). The Codex recovery refusal test in hook-identity-failclosed.test.ts stays unchanged.
5. tasks/packs.yml header comment states that the render-* verbs read the invoking checkout.
6. Release note as a changelog.d fragment.

items.title: No consumer `.gitattributes` block in this repository. `ensureGitattributes` returns without writing when the project directory is a framework-source checkout. The test is the marker test of `isFrameworkSourceCheckoutAt` (`main.md` plus the `DEFT_REPO_POSITIVE_MARKERS` files), which does not depend on whether a `.deft/core` or `deft/` directory exists. It is exported and reused, not copied. Every caller (`depositNeutralization`, `ensureManagedPathGitattributes`) gets the skip through the writer.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a linked worktree of this repository, when the setup repair path and the neutralization deposit run, then `.gitattributes` is unchanged; given a checkout of this repository that also has a `.deft/core` directory, then `.gitattributes` is unchanged.

items.title: Pack renders read the invoking checkout. When the invoking project root is a framework-source checkout by the same test, the pack-migrate verbs take the skills directory, `REFERENCES.md` and the output path from that one root. In any other project they resolve as today. The explicit `--skills-dir`, `--references-md` and `--out` flags still win.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a linked worktree of this repository with an edited SKILL.md, when pack-migrate-skills runs there, then the pack written in that worktree contains the edit and the references file and output are in that worktree; explicit flags still win; a consumer project resolves as today.

items.title: The pin-mismatch recovery admit and its tests are not changed by this story.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a Codex session where pin mismatch is the only fault, when `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` is sent with only the session directory, then the hook refuses as today (existing test unchanged).
